# arianet_load_balancer_target (Resource)

A target of a load balancer: a server, an IP, or every server matching a label selector (`add_target` / `remove_target` actions). Import ID: `<load_balancer_id>/<target_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "arianet_load_balancer_target" "web" {
  load_balancer_id = arianet_load_balancer.lb.id
  type             = "label_selector"
  label_selector   = "role=web"
  use_private_ip   = true
}

resource "arianet_load_balancer_target" "one" {
  load_balancer_id = arianet_load_balancer.lb.id
  type             = "server"
  server_id        = arianet_server.web.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `load_balancer_id` (Number) Load balancer.
- `type` (String) `server`, `ip` or `label_selector`.

### Optional

- `ip` (String) IP address, for type `ip`.
- `label_selector` (String) Label selector, for type `label_selector`.
- `server_id` (Number) Server, for type `server`.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `use_private_ip` (Boolean) Reach the target over the load balancer's private network.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Address the load balancer sends traffic to.
- `health_status` (String) `healthy`, `unhealthy` or `unknown`.
- `id` (String) `<load_balancer_id>/<target_id>`.
- `target_id` (Number) Target ID.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <load_balancer_id>/<target_id>
terraform import arianet_load_balancer_target.one 21/5
```
